name: Rahul Maurya
headline: Software Engineer · Backend & Distributed Systems · Java · Spring Boot · Microservices

au.summary: Software engineer with {years} years building and running high-availability, event-driven backend systems in Java and Spring Boot, from design to 24/7 production. Currently forward-deployed at a live customer site in Melbourne, where I raised fulfilment throughput by 50% and own production reliability across 20+ microservices. Strong in distributed systems, messaging (RabbitMQ, Kafka), Kubernetes, observability and incident root-cause analysis, with full-stack (Angular) and LLM tooling experience.

Looking for SDE-2 / backend roles at product companies.

experience.title: Software Engineer (Forward Deployed)
bullets: Forward-deployed on a 24/7, **20+ microservice** order-fulfilment platform (Java 17, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, SQL Server, Angular, Kubernetes / Helm) for a tier-1 global retail brand; own change requests end to end, from client scoping and estimation to production rollout.

Raised fulfilment throughput by **50% (800 → 1,200 totes/hr)** by measuring per-stage dwell time and fixing work release and allocation logic, closing the gap to the contracted SLA and unblocking a **seven-figure (AUD)** contractual milestone.

Led root-cause analysis for **20+ production incidents** across the distributed stack (consumer crashes, message storms, race conditions, retry drift), shipping fixes, runbooks, anomaly detectors and design / RCA documents that keep a live site running.

bullets.text: Built a cross-service irregular-event store (RabbitMQ → MongoDB) with Grafana alerting and Angular operator tools, replacing multi-pod log searches with a single correlated query.
Segregated competing business flows on shared automation (**+30%** client operational efficiency) and defined interface contracts with PLC and host-system (WMS) teams.
Forward-deployed on a second engagement, a metro rail project for a global engineering company: managed UAT test cases and defect triage with the client in Azure DevOps.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer

Built a real-time event pipeline on MongoDB with tuned MySQL / SQL Server queries, processing **10,000+ events/min with zero data loss** (idempotent consumers, dead-letter queues, replay).

bullets.text: Sustained **99.6% uptime** across production sites through Docker / Kubernetes deployments and Jenkins CI/CD.

bullets: Mentored interns in the India engineering team.
Built an LLM-powered inventory assistant (RAG plus read-only tool calls) that auto-resolves **75%+** of operator queries, reducing support tickets by **40%**.

bullets.text: Wrote a Python tool that migrates Grafana dashboards across 3 network environments (**200+ dashboards**), cutting each migration from **8 hours to 20 minutes**.
Delivered monitoring and hardware health dashboards that cut incident response time by **60%**; shipped WMS features to **5+ enterprise clients** in Scrum teams with QA, DevOps and Product.
